title: Lunar Research
purpose: Use lunar science and sustained local industry to unlock Quantum Technology—not Mars directly.
optimization_opportunities: Share power and logistics across experiments, keep lunar industry productive during research, and schedule around darkness.
infrastructure_reuse: The lunar base, automated mine, station platform, and orbital link become Quantum manufacturing infrastructure.

milestones.title: Lunar Science Program
final_validation: Complete the regolith, metallurgy, radiation, seismic, isotope, habitat, mining, communications, and precision-manufacturing studies available at the lunar base.

milestones.title: Darkness-Cycle Habitat Mastery
final_validation: Maintain habitation and industry through a full lunar darkness challenge.

milestones.title: Lunar Precision Manufacturing
final_validation: Manufacture a precision component locally and transmit production telemetry.

milestones.title: Lunar Engineering Archive
final_validation: Complete the lunar research program and assemble its results into a Lunar Engineering Archive.

milestones.title: Quantum Research Access
final_validation: Use the Lunar Engineering Archive to open Quantum Technology research; Mars remains locked.
